commands.help: Submit a query to search logs.

options.name: --time-start
options.help: Start filter log's date and time, in the format defined by RFC 3339.

options.name: --time-end
options.help: End filter log's date and time, in the format defined by RFC 3339.

options.name: --search-query
options.help: Query corresponding to the search operation.

options.name: --is-return-field-info
options.help: Whether to return field schema information for the log stream specified in searchQuery.

options.name: --limit
options.help: The maximum number of items to return in a response.
